title: Decision v1
description:
The authorization decision. Serves two roles with one shape:
  1) the response body of POST /v1/authorize, and
  2) the stored, tamper-evident audit record (GET /v1/decisions/{id}).

The signed portion (see Signature.canonicalization) covers the core verdict fields so the receipt is verifiable by any third party against the published Ed25519 public key. Record-only fields (record_hash, signature_verified) are added by the audit/read path and are NOT part of the signed bytes.

decision_id.description: Unique, sortable id for this decision.

verdict.description: The combined verdict from the combination algebra (TRD §5): any hard DENY ⇒ DENY; else any REVIEW ⇒ REVIEW; else all-satisfied ⇒ APPROVE.

policy_version_hash.description: Content hash of the exact compiled policy bundle version that produced this decision. Pins reproducibility and audit (TRD §6). Format is the publisher's hash scheme (e.g. 'pol_v3_9f2a1c...').

explanation.description: Structured, machine- and human-readable reasoning for the verdict (TRD §7).

summary.description: Plain-English one-line summary of why the verdict was reached.
examples: Transaction exceeds the monthly budget for procurement-agent.

matched_rules.description: Every rule that participated, with the numbers that drove it. An APPROVE lists its satisfied rules the same way a DENY lists the denying rule.

obligations.description: Conditions the caller must honor for the verdict to hold (e.g. capture within TTL, enrichment was skipped). Empty array on a clean APPROVE.

latency_ms.description: Server-measured decision latency in milliseconds (evaluation only; excludes the async audit write, which never adds to it).

evaluated_at.description: Echoes the orchestrator-injected evaluation instant from the request. Part of the replayable input vector and of the signed bytes.

shadow.description: True when produced under shadow/advisory mode: the decision was evaluated and logged but the caller MUST NOT enforce it (PRD §6, ROADMAP A#5). Absent/false = enforceable. Optional; defaults to false when omitted.

record_hash.description: RECORD-ONLY (audit read path, not signed). Hash chaining this decision to the previous audit record for the org, giving tamper-evidence over the log (TRD §12). Present on stored records, absent on the immediate authorize response.

signature_verified.description: RECORD-ONLY (computed at read time by GET /v1/decisions/{id}). True iff the stored signature validates against the published public key AND the record_hash chain is intact. Not part of the signed bytes.
